presentation.headline: Northstar dependency network
presentation.lede: The vendor forecast is late against the receiving need, while correctness, business reconciliation, and operations acceptance remain separate evidence boundaries.
presentation.insight_heading: Arrival, correctness, and acceptance need different evidence.
insight_points: M-DEP01 exposes a local date gap without asserting cutover impact.
The attachment-rule boundary keeps M-R01 as a risk until observation establishes an issue.
Business reconciliation and operations handover cannot be closed by a vendor done message.
presentation.decision: Obtain an authorized mapping forecast and validation plan, then date the receiving checks and downstream acceptance boundaries.

analysis.method: Rule-based coordination view plus provider/receiver pair counts. No integrated task network, calendars or resource model was supplied, so no critical path is asserted.

notes: All records are fictional training data.
The graph uses only facts available at the 23 October cutoff and explicitly labeled boundary proposals.
